title: Fixed-width recording and skip run
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $d$ be a configuration with $k+2$ work tapes, Boolean tape symbols, and record states. Let $\mathrm{bits}$ assign a bit to each of the $4k+4$ record positions. Suppose $d$ is in the initial state of the recording machine and, for every record position $i$, the table tape at the current table-head position plus $i$ contains $\mathrm{bits}(i)$. For each $u\le 4k+4$, running the record-and-skip machine for $u$ steps from the state-renamed configuration gives the state-renamed configuration that has read the first $u$ record bits (with the prescribed read configuration); after $4k+5$ steps, it gives the read configuration at full width, with its state renamed to the successor phase tagged as true.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration d with k+2 tapes and record states
Bit assignment on the 4k+4 record positions
d has the initial recording-machine state
Each specified table-tape cell contains its assigned bit
caveat: The phrase “read configuration” names the configuration construction supplied in the formal statement.
